summary: The approach of guarding comparisons with `is not None` is correct, but the implementation is incomplete: only `__lt__` was patched. `__le__`, `__gt__`, and `__ge__` still raise TypeError when a field holds None (and mixed str/num fields also crash), contradicting the issue which names all four operators. The single new test only covers `<`.
